description_en: Modifies the execution pattern of a backup task
description_zh: 修改备份任务执行模式
kebab_example: aliyun hsm config-backup-task --backup-id backup-1736207050000 --backup-period 3 --backup-hour-in-day 12 --manual-2-periodic-list image-haiduf23bj0000 --periodic-2-manual-list image-daiduahsbj0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigBackupTask

parameters.help_en: The automatic backup interval, in days. Valid values: 1, 3, 7, and 30
parameters.help_zh: 自动备份周期，单位天数。 取值为1、3、7、30
parameters.name: backup_period

parameters.help_en: The backup time in 24-hour format. Valid values: 1 to 24
parameters.help_zh: 备份时间，24小时制整点时间。取值：1~24
parameters.name: backup_hour_in_day

parameters.help_en: A list of image IDs to change from manual backup to automatic backup
parameters.help_zh: 手动备份更新为自动备份的镜像ID列表
parameters.name: manual_2_periodic_list

parameters.help_en: A list of image IDs to change from automatic backup to manual backup
parameters.help_zh: 自动备份更新为手动备份的镜像ID列表
parameters.name: periodic_2_manual_list
